data.name: Maruthu
data.gender_notes: Maruthu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Maruthu is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Marut', which refers to the god of wind. Maruthu is believed to be the charioteer of Indra, the god of rain and thunder. The name Maruthu carries the meaning “God of Wind” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Maruthu usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of transformation and renewal, representing the power of the wind to cleanse and bring new life.
data.etymology: Maruthu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Wind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maruthu total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Maruthu holds deep cultural significance in Hinduism. It resonates with the power and elegance of Indian mythology. Maruthu represents the connection between the natural elements, wind, and rain. In Indian representation, Maruthu is depicted as the guardian of the North-East direction and is integral to Hindu rituals and ceremonies.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Maruthu holds great significance. It embodies the idea of continuous transformation and the cyclical nature of life. Just as the wind carries seeds of change and brings new life to the earth, the name Maruthu represents the ability to adapt, transform, and grow. The spiritual essence of this name fosters a deep sense of respect for nature and the interconnectedness of all beings. Carrying this name inspires one to live in harmony with nature and honor its nurturing power.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Maruthu, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Maruth' which means 'the wind god', represents the embodiment of change and transformation. As the wind moves unpredictably, Maruthu symbolizes adaptability and resilience in the face of life's challenges.
